paper_title: New CAST Limit on the Axion-Photon Interaction
coupling_convention: |g_agamma| in GeV^-1, as plotted on the y-axis
notes: CAST final vacuum-phase solar axion result (2013-2015 data): g_agamma < 0.66e-10 GeV^-1 at 95% C.L., mass-independent for m_a <~ 0.02 eV (encoded as a flat line from 1e-4 eV, the lower edge of the paper's Fig. 2 exclusion plot, up to 0.02 eV where vacuum coherence is lost; bound actually extends to arbitrarily low masses). Solar axion helioscope search, so no local DM density assumption applies.
